categories.main_business_segments: Nichireki Group operates primarily in two business segments: (1) Asphalt Processed Products, which involves the manufacturing and sale of asphalt emulsions, modified asphalts, and related materials; and (2) Road Paving, which covers pavement construction, waterproofing, and related civil engineering works. The group also has a minor segment in real estate leasing and insurance agency services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include the formulation and production of high-performance modified asphalts, asphalt emulsions, and environmentally friendly paving materials. It emphasizes proprietary methods for long-life, low-noise, and low-temperature paving, as well as preventive maintenance surface treatments and specialized construction machinery. The group also leverages ICT and digital technologies to enhance productivity and quality in construction and maintenance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nichireki Group primarily serves public sector clients such as national and local governments, as well as private sector entities involved in infrastructure, transportation, and construction. Its main end markets are road infrastructure (highways, local roads), airports, ports, railways, and public facilities, with a significant focus on public works and infrastructure maintenance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are centered in Japan, with a nationwide network of branches, factories, and group companies. It also has a presence in select overseas markets, including China and Southeast Asia, through joint ventures and subsidiaries, but overseas sales account for less than 10% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nichireki Group operates both upstream and downstream in the supply chain: upstream as a manufacturer of asphalt-based materials, and downstream as a contractor for road paving and maintenance projects. It also acts as a supplier to other construction companies and public sector clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the group focuses on expanding and deepening its market presence, strengthening R&D for innovative, environmentally friendly, and high-performance products, and enhancing productivity through digital transformation and supply chain optimization. Key R&D themes include decarbonization, long-life infrastructure, recycling, safety, and cost efficiency. The company is investing in advanced logistics and production bases to support sustainability and ESG goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of asphalt processed products and the provision of road paving and construction services. Additional income comes from real estate leasing and insurance agency operations. The group recognizes revenue at the point of delivery for products and on a percentage-of-completion basis for construction contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nichireki Group is a leading player in Japan’s road materials and paving industry, competing with major construction and materials companies such as Nippon Road, Kajima Road, and other large general contractors. The company differentiates itself through its integrated approach, proprietary technologies, and strong public sector relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 2025, consolidated net sales were 75.7 billion yen, with operating profit of 6.3 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of 4.8 billion yen. The company has shown moderate growth in sales and profits, with a solid asset base (total assets of 112.4 billion yen) and a workforce of 1,386 employees. The group is targeting further growth through its mid-term plan, aiming for 80 billion yen in sales and 7 billion yen in operating profit by FY2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nichireki Group’s value proposition lies in its ability to provide high-performance, durable, and environmentally conscious road materials and construction solutions. The company emphasizes integrated consulting, advanced construction techniques, and proprietary products that address social needs such as infrastructure longevity, safety, and sustainability. Its reputation for reliability, technical expertise, and comprehensive service makes it a trusted partner for public and private infrastructure projects.
